body.intent: The review critic can confirm, downgrade or drop a blocker or major finding; a downgraded finding keeps the lower severity, so a real but minor defect no longer starts a fix cycle; review and plan review share one severity contract with a per-check mapping. Evidence: critics confirmed 242 of 246 blocker/major findings; 57% of runs needed a second review cycle (prompt-gap rec 5).
body.title: Critic downgrade
